svg.title: A code rule's match is a candidate, not a use
svg.text: A rule finds candidates. Which ones are uses is a reading.
85 lines a 12-pattern Ruby rule pack matched under app/, lib/ and config/
five exception handlers that name a class and call nothing
read by a model in context:
three calls each, the majority taken
its three calls agreed on 75 of the 85 and split two to one on the other 10; the judgement is each entry's pqch:in-use, labelled the model's
what a rule cannot decide: whether a line that names a library is a call, a comment, or a handler for an error
